summary: The whole top area of the browser window: the tab strip, navigation toolbar, and bookmarks bar together.
description: No class or customElements.define; navigator-toolbox.js attaches a single DOMContentLoaded listener to the #navigator-toolbox and #widget-overflow elements that delegates command/click/mousedown/mouseup/keypress/drag-and-drop events (by target id/selector) to the right chrome handler for buttons like back/forward/reload, bookmarks star, identity/tracking-protection icons, downloads, sync, and unified extensions.
